name: VocalSound: A Dataset for Improving Human Vocal Sounds Recognition
description: VocalSound is a dedicated audio dataset designed to advance non-speech human vocal sound classification and acoustic event detection. Curated by MIT CSAIL, it contains 21,024 clean audio recordings submitted by 3,365 human contributors across six fundamental non-speech vocal categories: laughter, sighs, coughs, throat-clearing, sneezes, and sniffs, collected across real-world acoustic backgrounds.
